faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (megaphone vergibt je Abruf eine request_event_id, megaphone haengt ein timetoken an, Adresse traegt eine session_id, kein ETag und Cache-Control "max-age=0, no-cache, no-store", Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst megaphone.fm) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

einzeiler: Megan Phelps-Roper explores ancient biblical stories in the new podcast Bookkeeper.
kurzfassung: Former Westboro Baptist Church member Megan Phelps-Roper reflects on her departure from the religious group and the lasting impact of biblical narratives. In the premiere episode, she examines the story of Joseph through the lens of family estrangement, injustice, and personal resilience. She explores how ancient stories continue to shape human psychology and offer frameworks for coping with modern trauma.
stichpunkte: Introduction to the new podcast Bookkeeper hosted by Megan Phelps-Roper
Phelps-Roper recounts leaving the Westboro Baptist Church and the resulting lifelong family estrangement
Discussion of how biblical stories remain deeply embedded in modern culture and personal identity
Detailed analysis of the biblical story of Joseph, his favored status, and his betrayal by his brothers
Joseph's enslavement in Egypt, his rise to power under Potiphar, and his unjust imprisonment
The years of waiting and maintaining integrity during what the host calls the long middle
Pharaoh's dreams of fat and lean cows interpreted by Joseph as seven years of plenty followed by famine
The reunion of Joseph with his brothers in Egypt and his emotional choice to offer forgiveness instead of revenge

clips.hook: Why a former religious extremist is still fascinated by biblical stories.
clips.text: Over a decade after leaving an infamous religious group, the host finds herself continually drawn back to the foundational stories of her upbringing and their ongoing influence on society.

clips.hook: Dating the biblical story of Joseph to the Bronze Age.
clips.text: The narrative is placed historically in the ancient Near East nearly four thousand years ago, long before the rise of classical Greek democracy or the Roman Empire.

clips.hook: Losing up to 20% of body weight in clinical trials.
clips.text: Participants in a medical study experienced significant weight reduction using a newly available medication alongside proper diet and exercise.

clips.hook: Refusing to let the wrongdoing of others dictate your character.
clips.text: Severe personal estrangement prompts a deeper reflection on breaking cycles of retaliation and choosing not to adopt the harmful behaviors of one's adversaries.

beschreibung:
Today we are sharing with you the first episode of a new series we’ve made here at Longview, called Book Keeper.

In our first episode of this series, host Megan Phelps-Roper, more than 10 years after leaving the Westboro Baptist Church, returns to the Bible. Even though she is no longer what most would consider a “believer,” she wants to explore what ancient wisdom still lives in these stories. And she begins with a tale of profound betrayal and reconciliation.
